previous.observation: Root actual own guide/raw/full white-black: closed down arcs, tiny smile and asymmetrical extended hands retained. Exactly two beads but both attach high beside cap leaves, not low ear/nape; coil starts above ear and sits outside shoulder, violating root attachment and shoulder-front placement. Lower end is pointed ribbon without a separately readable true small turn then C. Bob/black cloth have soft volume gradients. Raw outside gray cloud vanishes on WB, not certified alpha fog. Independent review pending; no whole-art acceptance or dynamic validation.
